text.p: These are the leading stories in the Mozambican press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- Mozambican President Joaquim Chissano returned to Maputo on Sunday after a one-day visit to Kinshasa where he attended a summit of ten African leaders to discuss the present situation in Congo-Kinshasa.

- Mario Dimande, Chairman of the board of Mozambique Railways, collapsed and died on a flight from Lisbon on Sunday, moments before the plane landed in Johannesburg. The cause of death is not yet known.
